name: International Typographic Style (Swiss Style)
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a directly named style in the source collection. Column-grid, baseline-aligned, asymmetric layouts with generous negative space; left-aligned sans-serif type with clear size hierarchy; black and white with restrained accent; grid-aligned photography. Elements animate along layout axes and settle on shared alignment points without disrupting reading order.
suitableUses: Explicit: posters, identity and typographic statements where grid and type carry everything; UI and product storytelling; editorial and minimalist layouts; motion posters and staged geometric compositions. Hybrid only when data must be explained or headlines must perform. Inferred fit: explainers with few verified figures. Audience, channel and duration unspecified.
limitations: Adapt or omit when recomposition hides the subject's hierarchy, a crop removes key detail, or pinning breaks layout or needs live scroll. Charts: no extra hues; flush-left labels only. Kinetic type: one sans family; weight and size steps only; no springs or overshoot; one red element per frame. Two-color checks don't cover text over images or video.
palette: Status: suggestion, used only when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #FFFFFF, foreground #000000, accent_1 #D32F2F (one restrained red). Layout roles only; never recolor assets. Contrast: #000 on #FFF 21:1; #FFF on #D32F2F 4.979:1 (meets 4.5 for normal text; recheck composited frames). No gradients; task or brand colors override.
motionAndInteraction: Video: author from composition time; move elements along horizontal and vertical layout axes; animate position, scale and cropping; settle on shared grid points; hold for reading; keep reading order. Kinetic type: linear-to-ease-out settling, no springs or overshoot. Web (hybrids): scroll, hover or keyboard only in interactive delivery; reduced motion disables axis slides or shows the static layout. Motion references 007, 012, 013, 015 are optional and screened per scene; choosing none is valid.
audio: Unspecified in source: music, voice, genre, tempo. Inferred: sparse or silent treatment suits the minimal look; keep speech clear of competing music. Use only user-chosen or authorized audio; verify sync and balance in the final video.
assetRequirements: Explicit: one sans-serif family, loaded before render; grid-aligned photography; SVG geometry aligned to the baseline grid; task or brand colors override the suggested palette; verified figures for chart layers; accurate image dimensions if a lightbox is used. Unspecified: typeface choice, photo sources, dimensions, duration, frame rate, audio assets.
combinations: Swiss alone for posters, identity and typographic statements. Hybrid with style-097: grid-drawn charts for annual reports, research summaries and explainers with verified figures; red only on the series under discussion. Hybrid with style-093: kinetic headlines for title sequences and manifestos; one red keyword per scene; no bounce. Keep black, white and red untouched in both.
productionApproach: HyperFrames by default: clip timing and one paused GSAP timeline in window.__timelines; use check, snapshot and render. Remotion only if HyperFrames is unavailable or verifiably limited; record why. Style renderer: HTML/CSS (Grid, transform) and SVG (viewBox, masks). Motion engine: GSAP for seekable timing; Motion optional after seek checks. Verify key frames, decoded video and audio sync.
